propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a reminder when grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, to redirect agents toward Serena symbol tools for reference finding
The hook trigger must be a simple string match for grep-family invocations with no pattern classification or path heuristics, accepting false positives over false negatives
The reminder message must be <= 3 lines, reference both find_referencing_symbols and exceptions (string literals, line numbers), and be emitted as JSON to hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext
The hook must not block execution (no permissionDecision field, exit code never 2) and must not suppress permission prompts
The hook implementation must be in a tracked, testable script (scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py) rather than inline JSON
The change must preserve the existing env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting from story C when merging hooks configuration into .claude/settings.json
